title: Lake Al'Ameth
wikitext:
[[Image:Lake Al'Ameth.jpg|thumb|Lake Al'Ameth]]
'''Lake Al'Ameth''' is the largest body of water in [[Teldrassil]] aside from the great pools of [[Darnassus]]. The lake lies south of [[Dolanaar]]. Lately, enraged [[timberling]]s have been sighted on the shores of the lake, and it is no longer safe.
